review.notes: Machine-drafted ladder unit (adapter-sq@8); awaiting a named native reviewer (npm run review:packet). Invented first-person account of a storm. Check imperfect/aorist ("po flisnim kur ... bërtiti"), "duke" + participle, and the adapter gaps: the imperfect "bërtiste" is not read by the adapter, so the aorist "bërtiti" is used.

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.text: Të shtunën në mbrëmje isha te Ana dhe Luani për darkë.
sentences.english: On Saturday evening I was at Ana and Luan's for supper.

sentences.text: Ardi ishte edhe ai atje, sepse flinte te Ana.
sentences.english: Ardi was there too, because he was sleeping at Ana's.

sentences.text: Ana po gatuante një byrek me spinaq dhe Luani po pastronte spinaqin.
sentences.english: Ana was cooking a spinach byrek and Luan was cleaning the spinach.

sentences.text: Ata përzienin miellin, vezët dhe kripën.
sentences.english: They were mixing the flour, the eggs and the salt.

sentences.text: Ana hodhi pak vaj në byrek dhe shtoi kos të trashë.
sentences.english: Ana poured a little oil onto the byrek and added thick yoghurt.

sentences.text: Luani e priste spinaqin me thikë, dhe unë sillja lugët dhe pjatat.
sentences.english: Luan was cutting the spinach with a knife, and I was bringing the spoons and the plates.

sentences.text: Furra ishte e ngrohtë dhe byreku piqej.
sentences.english: The oven was warm and the byrek was baking.

sentences.text: Ardi po lexonte një libër në dhomën e tij.
sentences.english: Ardi was reading a book in his room.

sentences.text: Ishte një mbrëmje e bukur, por jashtë qielli ishte i zi.
sentences.english: It was a lovely evening, but outside the sky was black.

sentences.text: Pas pak u dëgjua një bubullimë e madhe.
sentences.english: Soon a loud clap of thunder was heard.

sentences.text: Pastaj pamë një vetëtimë të bardhë.
sentences.english: Then we saw a white flash of lightning.

sentences.text: Çdo vetëtimë e bënte kuzhinën të bardhë dhe pastaj të zezë.
sentences.english: Every flash of lightning made the kitchen white and then black.

sentences.text: — Stuhi! — tha Luani, duke shikuar nga dritarja.
sentences.english: "A storm!" said Luan, looking out of the window.

sentences.text: Ra shi dhe era u bë shumë e madhe.
sentences.english: Rain fell and the wind became very strong.

sentences.text: Atëherë drita u fik.
sentences.english: Then the light went out.

sentences.text: Kuzhina nuk kishte dritë, por furra ishte e ngrohtë.
sentences.english: The kitchen had no light, but the oven was warm.

sentences.text: Ana tha: — Mos lëvizni, ju lutem!
sentences.english: Ana said: "Do not move, please!"

sentences.text: Luani ndezi një llambë dhe e la në tavolinë.
sentences.english: Luan lit a lamp and left it on the table.

sentences.text: Hijet tona ishin të mëdha në mur.
sentences.english: Our shadows were big on the wall.

sentences.text: — Nuk ka rrezik — tha ai. — Është një stuhi.
sentences.english: "There is no danger," he said. "It is a storm."

sentences.text: Ne po flisnim kur Ardi bërtiti nga dhoma.
sentences.english: We were talking when Ardi shouted from his room.

sentences.text: Pastaj dëgjuam një zë tjetër: dritarja u thye.
sentences.english: Then we heard another sound: the window broke.

sentences.text: Ne vrapuam te dhoma e tij.
sentences.english: We ran to his room.

sentences.text: — A ka rrezik te dritarja? — pyeta unë.
sentences.english: "Is there danger by the window?" I asked.

sentences.text: Era e madhe e kishte thyer dritaren.
sentences.english: The strong wind had broken the window.

sentences.text: Ardi ishte në shtrat dhe po qante.
sentences.english: Ardi was in bed and was crying.

sentences.text: Ai bërtiti edhe një herë: — Ana!
sentences.english: He shouted once more: "Ana!"

sentences.text: Shkaku ishte era e madhe.
sentences.english: The cause was the strong wind.

sentences.text: Luani vërejti se era hynte nga dritarja e thyer.
sentences.english: Luan noticed that the wind was coming in through the broken window.

sentences.text: Unë vërejta gjithashtu që shiu hynte brenda.
sentences.english: I also noticed that the rain was coming in.

sentences.text: Unë e kapa dorën e tij dhe i thashë: — Mos qaj, Ardi. Jam këtu.
sentences.english: I took his hand and said to him: "Do not cry, Ardi. I am here."

sentences.text: Ai nuk lëvizte dhe nuk fliste.
sentences.english: He did not move and did not speak.

sentences.text: Ana e mori pranë dhe tha: — Hesht tani, nuk ka rrezik.
sentences.english: Ana took him close and said: "Hush now, there is no danger."

sentences.text: Luani kapi llambën, e ktheu nga dera dhe e çoi në dhomën e Ardit.
sentences.english: Luan picked up the lamp, turned it towards the door and took it to Ardi's room.

sentences.text: Unë vërejta se asgjë nuk ra mbi shtratin e Ardit.
sentences.english: I noticed that nothing fell on Ardi's bed.

sentences.text: Ai nuk kishte asgjë, por kishte frikë.
sentences.english: He was not hurt, but he was afraid.

sentences.text: — Nuk ka shkak për frikë — tha Ana. — Dritarja u thye, por Ardi shpëtoi.
sentences.english: "There is no reason for fear," said Ana. "The window broke, but Ardi is safe."

sentences.text: — Pa shkak nuk qan njeri — tha Ana.
sentences.english: "Nobody cries without a reason," said Ana.

sentences.text: — Kam frikë nga bubullima — tha Ardi.
sentences.english: "I am afraid of the thunder," said Ardi.

sentences.text: Ana e çoi në kuzhinë, pranë furrës, ku ishte e ngrohtë.
sentences.english: Ana took him to the kitchen, near the oven, where it was warm.

sentences.text: Aty ai ishte më mirë.
sentences.english: There he was better.

sentences.text: Ana ktheu byrekun në furrë dhe e fiku furrën pas pak.
sentences.english: Ana turned the byrek over in the oven and switched the oven off a little later.

sentences.text: Byreku shpëtoi dhe ne ishim të lumtur.
sentences.english: The byrek was saved and we were happy.

sentences.text: Ne hëngrëm duke dëgjuar bubullimën.
sentences.english: We ate listening to the thunder.

sentences.text: Zëri i Luanit ishte i ngrohtë dhe i ulët.
sentences.english: Luan's voice was warm and low.

sentences.text: — Faleminderit Zotit që shpëtuam të gjithë — tha Ana.
sentences.english: "Thank God that we were all saved," said Ana.

sentences.text: Luani e la llambën në tavolinë, dhe ne ulëm bashkë pa asnjë dritë tjetër.
sentences.english: Luan left the lamp on the table, and we sat down together without any other light.

sentences.text: Ardi heshti dhe dëgjoi bubullimën.
sentences.english: Ardi fell silent and listened to the thunder.

sentences.text: Edhe unë heshta një minutë.
sentences.english: I too was silent for a minute.

sentences.text: Pas çdo vetëtime ai mbyllte sytë.
sentences.english: After every flash of lightning he closed his eyes.

sentences.text: Ana fliste me zë të ulët: — Mos bërtit, Ardi, dhe mos ki frikë.
sentences.english: Ana spoke in a low voice: "Do not shout, Ardi, and do not be afraid."

sentences.text: — Kam kujtime të stuhive — tha Luani.
sentences.english: "I have memories of storms," said Luan.

sentences.text: — Dikur, kur isha i vogël, stuhia më kapi në breg të lumit.
sentences.english: "Once, when I was small, a storm caught me on the bank of the river."

sentences.text: — Unë vrapova në shtëpi dhe dhitë vraponin pas meje.
sentences.english: "I ran home and the goats were running after me."

sentences.text: — Një herë stuhia e mori çatinë e shtëpisë së vjetër.
sentences.english: "One time a storm took the roof of the old house."

sentences.text: — Çatia e shtëpisë së vjetër ishte e ulët dhe dhomat ishin të ngushta.
sentences.english: "The roof of the old house was low and the rooms were narrow."

sentences.text: — Pas stuhisë shkonim në lumë: notonim, ngjiteshim në shkëmb dhe luanim në rërë.
sentences.english: "After the storm we went to the river: we swam, climbed up on the rock and played in the sand."

sentences.text: — Atëherë gjyshi ndizte zjarrin në sobë dhe thoshte: stuhia është e shkurtër.
sentences.english: "Then grandfather lit the fire in the stove and said: the storm is short."

sentences.text: — Pas stuhisë vinte mjegulla, dhe unë dilja te liqeni me dhitë.
sentences.english: "After the storm the fog came, and I went out to the lake with the goats."

sentences.text: Ardi buzëqeshi pak.
sentences.english: Ardi smiled a little.

sentences.text: — Gjyshi më tregoi për djalin trim dhe për gjarprin e shpellës — tha ai.
sentences.english: "Grandfather told me about the brave boy and the snake of the cave," he said.

sentences.text: — Djali zbriti shkallët dhe nuk kishte frikë, edhe pse ishte i vetëm.
sentences.english: "The boy went down the stairs and was not afraid, although he was alone."

sentences.text: — Edhe unë dua të jem trim.
sentences.english: "I want to be brave too."

sentences.text: — Je trim, Ardi — i thashë unë. — Tani nuk je i vetëm.
sentences.english: "You are brave, Ardi," I said to him. "Now you are not alone."

sentences.text: Ne hëngrëm byrek me dritën e llambës, duke folur për fshatin dhe për verën.
sentences.english: We ate byrek by the light of the lamp, talking about the village and about summer.

sentences.text: Hijet në mur lëviznin, por Ardi nuk kishte më frikë.
sentences.english: The shadows on the wall moved, but Ardi was no longer afraid.

sentences.text: Luani bëri një lojë me hijet dhe me duart e tij.
sentences.english: Luan made a game with the shadows and with his hands.

sentences.text: Në mur ishte një qen dhe pastaj një zog.
sentences.english: On the wall there was a dog and then a bird.

sentences.text: Ardi buzëqeshi dhe unë gjithashtu.
sentences.english: Ardi smiled and so did I.

sentences.text: Ana më dha një pjesë të hollë byreku.
sentences.english: Ana gave me a thin piece of byrek.

sentences.text: — Në këtë vend stuhia vjen shpesh — tha ajo.
sentences.english: "In this country the storm comes often," she said.

sentences.text: — Çdo vit ka disa stuhi në qytet, por kjo ishte e rëndë.
sentences.english: "Every year there are a few storms in the town, but this one was heavy."

sentences.text: Ardi rrinte pranë meje dhe hante.
sentences.english: Ardi sat next to me and ate.

sentences.text: Ai ishte një djalë i vogël dhe kishte një lloj frike që nuk e kuptonte.
sentences.english: He was a small boy and had a kind of fear that he did not understand.

sentences.text: Pas një ore drita u kthye.
sentences.english: After an hour the light came back.

sentences.text: Luani ndezi dritën e kuzhinës dhe fiku llambën.
sentences.english: Luan switched on the kitchen light and put out the lamp.

sentences.text: Tani pamë dhomën e Ardit: dritarja ishte e lartë, e gjerë dhe e thyer.
sentences.english: Now we saw Ardi's room: the window was high, wide and broken.

sentences.text: Nuk ishte një punë e lehtë të mbyllnim atë dritare.
sentences.english: It was not an easy job to close that window.

sentences.text: Luani mbylli derën e dhomës dhe ktheu çelësin në portën e shtëpisë.
sentences.english: Luan closed the door of the room and turned the key in the door of the house.

sentences.text: Pastaj ai i telefonoi një miku.
sentences.english: Then he phoned a friend.

sentences.text: — Nesër do të vijë një shok dhe do të blejë një dritare të re — tha ai.
sentences.english: "Tomorrow a friend will come and will buy a new window," he said.

sentences.text: Luani e çoi Ardin në shtratin e madh. Ardi nuk flinte pa dritë, prandaj Ana la një llambë të vogël.
sentences.english: Luan took Ardi to the big bed. Ardi did not sleep without a light, so Ana left a small lamp.

sentences.text: Unë rrija pranë dritares, por tani jashtë nuk binte më shi.
sentences.english: I was sitting by the window, but now it was no longer raining outside.

sentences.text: Ishte një natë e vështirë për Ardin.
sentences.english: It was a hard night for Ardi.

sentences.text: — Ishte një natë e vështirë për të gjithë — tha Luani.
sentences.english: "It was a hard night for everyone," said Luan.

sentences.text: Në këtë mënyrë stuhia na solli bashkë.
sentences.english: In this way the storm brought us together.

sentences.text: Mësova një gjë: në një stuhi njeri nuk është i vetëm.
sentences.english: I learned one thing: in a storm no one is alone.
